commits.body:
A null array and a negative offset or count can have two different Java exceptions. Both native engines now consult the selected bootstrap constructor, including the exception's own bytecode in Java 8. A check without runtime bytes refuses the ambiguous case. Five real JVMs and five strict native probes agreed: Java 8 reported bounds, bounds, null while Java 11, 17, 21 and 25 reported null three times. All 18 values tests and the 43 changed-test suites passed.

Freeze two separate transfer cases: Eclipse Collections' 2,865 bounded insertions and JavaParser's two traversal shapes with identity and exhaustion controls. Historical build jobs 20261121-102122-359 and 20261121-102122-360 replace the first attempts, which reached the unrelated Eclipse P2 plugin and the incompatible Java 21 SequencedCollection API respectively. Their JDK 17 builds supply original JARs for JDK 21 observations. Jobs starting 20261121-102303 through 20261121-102305 repeat all primary native and finite checks and both Lang selector proofs on this tree.

Recount actual test XML and original bytecode receipts, including Surefire's named assertion source lines when malformed UTF-16 truncates its XML stack message. The ordered Hadoop run finished all ten finite obligations and reached real external initialization in both strict routes. The scorecard independently reconstructed 36 of 46 native and 46 of 46 finite outcomes ahead of the final repeat.
